title: Blacker-than-black holes above the insulator ring

tellings.quote: at all. They almost look like a bottomless pits in there. But I know they're solid.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft in 1988 and 1989 at S-4, a secret site in Nevada, describes holes above a part of a craft he calls the insulator ring. He says they looked blacker than black, like bottomless pits, though he knew they were solid, and he mentions a man named Barry. He tells it as one of the strange details he says he saw up close.
